adjudication.rationale: The diff shows server-side input validation for `addGuests` uses `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` from `addGuests.schema.ts`, which is only `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` (no uniqueness check). Meanwhile the client (`AddGuestsDialog.tsx`) defines its own local schema `z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` to enforce uniqueness. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` (lines ~74-78) filters only against existing attendees and a blacklist, not duplicates within the submitted `guests`, so `['a@b.com','a@b.com']` would both pass to `createMany`, potentially creating duplicate attendees and causing duplicate emails/ICS entries (or a Prisma unique constraint error if one exists). This is a real, diff-grounded correctness issue and a client/server validation drift.
